import xarray as xr


def test_merge_combine_attrs_override_copies_attrs():
    """Test that merge with combine_attrs='override' copies attrs, not references."""
    xds1 = xr.Dataset(attrs={'a': 'b'})
    xds2 = xr.Dataset(attrs={'a': 'c'})
    
    # Before merge, attrs are distinct
    assert xds1.a == 'b'
    assert xds2.a == 'c'
    
    # Merge with combine_attrs='override'
    xds3 = xr.merge([xds1, xds2], combine_attrs='override')
    
    # After merge, xds3 should have attrs from first object
    assert xds3.a == 'b'
    
    # Modifying merged dataset's attrs should NOT affect the source
    xds3.attrs['a'] = 'd'
    
    # Source datasets should be unaffected
    assert xds1.a == 'b', f"Expected xds1.a to still be 'b', got {xds1.a}"
    assert xds2.a == 'c', f"Expected xds2.a to still be 'c', got {xds2.a}"
    assert xds3.a == 'd', f"Expected xds3.a to be 'd', got {xds3.a}"
